title: Kelleyville Bridge, Spanning Sugar River at State Route11/103, Newport, Sullivan County, NH
notes: Significance: The bridge is a representative example of a concrete open-spandrel arch deck bridge, typical of early 20th century concrete bridge technology. The bridge carries Route 11/103 over the Sugar River, a road of historical significance to New Hampshire.
